name: agentic-system-core
description: Read, cite, compose and remember over a Markdown knowledge Bundle, as MCP tools over stdio.
long_description: AgenticSystemCore turns a folder of Markdown into a knowledge node that people and agents can both read, verify and cite. This extension runs the reference engine's tool server over one such folder (a Bundle: a folder initialised with `agsc init`, which holds `agsc.config.json`). Ten tools search, read and cite items by their IRIs, follow their typed links, compose a selection and its brief, explain and check it, and hand back changes as Proposal payloads for a person to merge; no tool writes to the folder, and no model is called. Documentation: https://agenticsystemcore.com/docs/how-to-use/

bundle_dir.title: Knowledge folder (Bundle)
bundle_dir.description: A folder of Markdown initialised with `npx agentic-system-core init` (it holds agsc.config.json). The tools read it; none of them writes to it.
